newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli CPI bonds end up ahead of rate decision.
newsitem.headline: Israeli CPI bonds end up ahead of rate decision.

text.p: Israeli inflation-linked bonds closed higher in dull trading on Sunday amid institutional purchasing ahead of the Bank of Israel's interest rate decision on Monday, traders said.
* Unlinked government bonds (Gilon -- issued for four years): +0.06 pct to 172.68
* Bank of Israel short-term Makam bills: +0.08 pct to 162.74
Volume was a very low 85 million shekels with activity in unlinked bonds falling to only 29 million shekels.

"CPI-linked bonds continued to rise today on moderate demand from institutional buyers. The big mutual funds will prevent the market from falling until the end of the year," said Ari Eidelheit of Zeller Eblagon Securities.

"Yields on inflation-linked long bonds fell to 4.41 percent, which is relatively low. Redemptions in the mutual and provident funds have dropped sharply and they are investing more money in long bonds," said Gidi Halperin of Meitav Securities and Investments.

Halperin said investors are more confident now that the Bank of Israel is expected to lower short-term rates by 0.3-0.5 percentage point. The Bank of Israel will announce its January monetary programme, including interest rates, on Monday after the close of trading.
"Investors are very optimistic ahead of the rate announcement," Halperin said. "In the next three months the central bank is expected to lower the rates by 1.5 to two percentage points."
Unlinked bonds also rose today. "With yields of 15-15.5 percent and expectations for 1997 inflation of 10 percent these bonds are still very attractive," Eidelheit said.
Traders said Makams rose moderately on relatively low volume of 21 million shekels.
Dollar-linked bonds fell following the rise of the shekel against the U.S. currency on Friday, when the dollar was fixed at 3.270 shekels against 3.278 on Thursday.
Note: Makams are zero-coupon unlinked certificates with durations of three months to one year. The Bank of Israel issues Makams to absorb liquidity.
